max_tables_desc.en: Maximum number of mapping tables. Loading a new table beyond this limit is rejected; replacing an existing table is always allowed.
max_tables_desc.zh: 映射表数量上限。超过上限后无法加载新表；替换已有表不受限制。

max_rows_per_table_desc.en: Maximum number of rows in a single mapping table. A table file with more rows is rejected as a whole.
max_rows_per_table_desc.zh: 单个映射表的行数上限。超过上限的表文件将被整体拒绝。
